answer: In a reef survey market, give each established customer a fixed daily endorsement budget to divide among agents. An endorsement is a signal of completed work; budgets grow only after randomly audited paid jobs, so aliases cannot instantly multiply the reward oasis. A farmer must fund jobs and wait through audits to gain influence. The weakness is deciding which customers are independent: colluders can trade fake jobs, and growth caps may slow honest newcomers. Publish audit receipts and test job evidence rather than trusting account age alone.
